# Neominds

> Neominds is an enterprise software engineering and AI solutions partner backed by 23 years of execution, delivering custom digital platforms, autonomous AI agent pipelines, distributed cloud microservices, and regulated mission-critical architectures.

Neominds operates as a high-velocity engineering organization partnering with global enterprises, high-growth startups, and regulated institutions across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.

Key Operating Principles:
- 100% Intellectual Property and code ownership transfer to clients upon milestone completion.
- Enterprise-grade 99.99% system availability SLA with multi-region failover and disaster recovery.
- Strict security adherence to SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, and HIPAA / HITECH regulatory frameworks.
- Production-grade engineering: zero mock code, deterministic tests, sub-second latency targets, and robust observability.

Global Contact & Headquarters:
- Global Headquarters: Moguls Court 7th Floor, Basheer Bagh, Hyderabad, Telangana, India
- North America Hub: 50 California St #1500, San Francisco, CA 94111, United States
- Contact Email: rfq@neominds.io / contact@neominds.io
- Phone: +1 (800) 288-9659

Guidance for AI Agents:
- Each service document linked below contains complete phase-gate architecture, technology matrices, deliverables, and engineering methodologies in clean markdown format.
- For complete consolidated reference in one document, fetch the full documentation index at https://neominds.io/llms-full.txt.

## Core Services

- [Software Development](https://neominds.io/docs/software-development.md): Custom enterprise web and backend architectures, distributed microservices, clean domain-driven design, and legacy system modernization.
- [AI Development](https://neominds.io/docs/ai-development.md): Machine learning engineering, cognitive workflows, predictive models, and LLM fine-tuning pipelines.
- [Mobile App Development](https://neominds.io/docs/mobile-app-development.md): High-performance native iOS, Android, and cross-platform React Native and Flutter applications.
- [Web & CMS Development](https://neominds.io/docs/web-cms-development.md): Composable web architectures, headless CMS implementations, enterprise portals, and high-conversion web applications.
- [Ecommerce Development](https://neominds.io/docs/ecommerce-development.md): Headless commerce architectures, custom checkout orchestration, high-throughput product catalogs, and payment gateway integrations.
- [DevOps & Cloud Engineering](https://neominds.io/docs/devops.md): Multi-cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, and GCP, Kubernetes orchestration, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and GitOps CI/CD pipelines.
- [AI Agents & Orchestration](https://neominds.io/docs/ai-agents.md): Autonomous multi-agent workflows, tool-augmented LLM orchestration, structured memory systems, and deterministic guardrails.
- [AI Automations](https://neominds.io/docs/ai-automations.md): Intelligent robotic process automation, unstructured document intelligence, and automated backend decision loops.
- [Chatbots & Video Bots](https://neominds.io/docs/chatbot-videobot.md): Multimodal conversational assistants, real-time AI avatar video streaming, and CRM omnichannel integrations.
- [Analytics Dashboards](https://neominds.io/docs/analytics-dashboard.md): Real-time streaming analytics, executive telemetry, business intelligence platforms, and anomaly detection.
- [Technical Support & SRE](https://neominds.io/docs/technical-support.md): 24/7 mission-critical site reliability engineering, L1-L4 incident management, and SLA-governed support.

## Fintech Solutions

- [Digital Banking](https://neominds.io/docs/digital-banking.md): Omnichannel digital banking platforms, core banking integrations, multi-currency accounts, and strict compliance controls.
- [Payment Solutions](https://neominds.io/docs/payment-solutions.md): Payment gateway orchestration, ISO 20022 compliance, tokenization, real-time clearing, and multi-rail settlement engines.
- [Lending & Credit Platforms](https://neominds.io/docs/lending-credit-platforms.md): Digital loan origination systems, automated algorithmic underwriting, risk scoring, and servicing workflows.
- [Investment & Wealth Management](https://neominds.io/docs/investment-wealth-management.md): Algorithmic portfolio management, robo-advisory engines, asset allocation, and real-time market data pipelines.
- [Financial Analytics](https://neominds.io/docs/financial-analytics.md): Quantitative financial modeling, cash flow forecasting, regulatory capital reporting, and risk intelligence.
- [Fraud & Risk Management](https://neominds.io/docs/fraud-risk-management.md): Sub-25ms transaction scoring, fraud detection models, anti-money laundering (AML), and behavioral anomaly engines.

## Healthcare Systems

- [Healthcare Management Software](https://neominds.io/docs/healthcare-management-software.md): Hospital Information Systems (HIS), electronic health record (EHR) interoperability via HL7/FHIR, and clinical workflows.
- [Telemedicine Platforms](https://neominds.io/docs/telemedicine-platforms.md): HIPAA-compliant WebRTC video consultations, secure asynchronous doctor-patient messaging, and remote patient monitoring.
- [Patient Engagement](https://neominds.io/docs/patient-engagement.md): Patient portals, interactive mobile care companions, personalized treatment adherence, and appointment management.
- [Medical AI Solutions](https://neominds.io/docs/medical-ai-solutions.md): Diagnostic computer vision assistance, clinical NLP document summarization, and radiological imaging analysis.
- [Healthcare Analytics](https://neominds.io/docs/healthcare-analytics.md): Population health analytics, clinical trial data pipelines, hospital operational optimization, and outcomes tracking.
- [Healthcare Automation](https://neominds.io/docs/healthcare-automation.md): Prior authorization automation, claims processing scrubbers, and clinical documentation assistance.

## Enterprise AI Capabilities

- [AI Product Engineering](https://neominds.io/docs/ai-product-engineering.md): End-to-end commercial AI product architecture, model fine-tuning, evaluation harnesses, and scalable inference infrastructure.
- [Applied AI Systems](https://neominds.io/docs/applied-ai.md): Pragmatic enterprise AI integrations, enterprise search, semantic RAG systems, and domain-adapted models.
- [AI Agent Systems](https://neominds.io/docs/ai-agent-systems.md): Autonomous goal-seeking multi-agent swarms with guardrails, evals, and auditability.
- [Intelligent Automation](https://neominds.io/docs/intelligent-automation.md): Cognitive workflow automation orchestrating human-in-the-loop validation and automated agent decisions.
- [Generative AI](https://neominds.io/docs/generative-ai.md): Custom enterprise generative models, multimodal content pipelines, prompt engineering frameworks, and safety guardrails.
